alphavantage.description: Alpha Vantage market data: quotes, daily prices, company fundamentals, news sentiment, movers and indicators. Pass datatype: "json" for parsed JSON (the default is CSV text). Free key: 1 request per second and 25 per day, so call tools one at a time with a short pause, never in parallel. Never pass entitlement (free keys have no realtime or delayed access). Errors come back as data, not exceptions, e.g. { error: { type: "rate_limit", message } }: check for an "error" key before using a result.
